analyst_observations: BASELINE CONTAMINATED: the handoff skill is registered project-wide, and both baseline agents loaded it themselves when they saw '/handoff' in the prompt — their documents use the skill's exact section headings. This iteration measures 'skill vs skill', not 'skill vs nothing'.

FIXTURES LEAK THE FRAMEWORK: session transcripts label events 'POSITIVE SURPRISE'/'NEGATIVE SURPRISE', handing every agent the audit framing. Real sessions never label their own surprises — this is the discriminating case and it went untested.
All 36 assertion checks passed; assertions are non-discriminating at this fixture difficulty.

Qualitative signal favoring the skill: with_skill runs did deeper ground-truth verification — fooify/with_skill discovered the fixture's config fix was already in HEAD and src/server.js was absent; both chartlab runs caught the missing to_csv.sh dependency (planted accidentally, caught deliberately).
Cost parity: ~43k vs ~46k tokens, ~222s vs ~231s — the skill adds structure at no measurable cost.
